answer: Require each new agent to post a refundable bond and be vouched by an established peer who stakes collateral that is slashed if the vouchee misbehaves. A lone sybil can wander the edges, but to enter the trusted grove it must purchase a vouch backed by real capital. Spinning up a whole nebula of fake identities then costs one bond plus one at-risk stake per node, so large sybil fleets become uneconomical rather than free.
